scope: A rotary-annulus abstraction of the original circular conveyor: bounded torque turns the original fused rail/roller assembly; its free carrier and original target move through contacts. This tests contact transfer, not individual powered rollers, belt deformation, or a real conveyor installation.
backend: OvPhysX0.4.13 native CPU PhysX on Horde
controller: Settle1s; half-cosine rail target ramp1.7rad over10s; hold2s. Torque PD kp0.1Nm/rad,kd0.02Nms/rad,limit0.02Nm. Tiny independent lateral payload force0.0005N with seeded +/-0.0001N perpendicular jitter during6..6.5s. No pose/velocity writes during stepping.
acceptance: All five seeds: rail, carrier and payload each advance >=1.45rad; identified carrier/rail and payload/carrier contact on >=90% of transport frames2..11s; carrier radial error<=7mm,height error<=4mm; payload radial error<=12mm,height error<=8mm,center remains >3mm above carrier and within25mm; penetration<=1.5mm, joint-anchor error<=1mm,axis error<=0.02rad,speed<=1m/s,spin<=20rad/s,finite native state and independent gravity witness. Exactly one rail revolute joint, no carrier/payload attachment.
source_fidelity: All four original source assembly-world shape instances retained visibly at original world placement in metres/Z-up; identity assembly_from_source. Surface tolerance max(50um,0.001*part diagonal). Moving visual source must inherit the declared body; support stays static. Added collision approximations are invisible/proxy/guide, never replacements for source visuals.
normalization: Evaluator disables authored joint drives, resets initial velocities to rest, uses Earth gravity and uniform solver iterations, enables contact reports, and creates a distant free-fall witness. Original collider geometry remains submitted geometry.
assumptions: Authored masses, inertia and friction are simulation assumptions; geometry fidelity is relative to the independently meshed original STEP. No real-hardware or per-roller actuation validation.
